name: 円香
text: とりあえず、着替えたけど……
trans: Well, we changed out of the wet clothes but......

name: 円香
text:
……こんな状態で
帰ることになるなんて
trans: ......Didn't think we'll be heading back in such a manner.

name: 雛菜
text:
服すっごく濡れてたから
ビニール入れといた～
trans:
Our clothes are totally drenched so I put them into
plastic bags～

name: 小糸
text:
わ、わたしの傘が
もっと大きかったらよかったんだけど……
trans: I-If only my umbrella was just, a little bit bigger......

name: 雛菜
trans: The wind was so strong too, huh～

name: 透
text:
やばかった
めっちゃ

name: 小糸
text:
ご、ごめんね……
傘、小さくて……！

name: 雛菜
trans: Hey, I can't see anything though～?

name: 円香
text: 傘、壊れちゃったんでしょ？

name: 円香
text:
最後、浅倉が傘を使って返した後
しまおうとしたらポッキリだって
trans:
Right before we headed back and Asakura wanted to
return it, the frame collapsed as she closed it.

name: 円香
text:
そもそも
あの中を傘差して走れば、そりゃ壊れる
trans:
In the first place,
it's a given that the umbrella would have broke,
running and holding it against such heavy rain.

name: 小糸
text:
こ、壊れちゃったけど……
いいんだ

name: 小糸
text: ちょっとでも、みんなの役に立てたなら……！
trans: I'm glad it helped everyone, even just a little......!

name: 雛菜
text:
でも、小糸ちゃんの傘
弁償しなくちゃだね～
trans:
But we should compensate you, right～?
For your umbrella.

name: 小糸
text:
ぴぇ！？
い、いいよ……そんな……

name: 円香
text:
じゃ、次も同じようなことがあった時
傘に入れてもらう代として
trans:
Then, how about taking it as payment for letting
us in your umbrella again on future occasions
like this.

name: 雛菜
trans: That might be a good idea～

name: 小糸
text:
そ、そんなことしなくても
いつでも入れてあげるんだけど……
trans: I-I'd let you all in even if you don't pay......

name: 小糸
text: でも、そういうことなら……
trans: But, if you guys put it that way......

name: 円香
text:
うちらで出すなら
わりとしっかりした傘が買えるんじゃない
trans:
If we all chip in to buy one,
maybe you'll be able to get a studier one.

name: 雛菜
text:
それも大事だけど
かわいい方がいいよね～
trans:
That's important, but it's more important
to get a cute one, right～?

name: 円香
trans: What type of umbrella do you want, Koito?

name: 小糸
text:
みんなで入れるくらい
大きくて、しっかりしてて……
trans:
I want one that's sturdy,
and big enough so that everyone can fit in it......

name: 小糸
text: でも、軽いやつだといいな……！
trans: But it'll be nice if it's light, too......!

name: 雛菜
text: 今日はこのまま帰るでしょ～？
trans: We'll be heading back right after this, right～?

name: 雛菜
trans: So how about we go tomorrow?

name: 小糸
text:
わ、わたしはみんなに合わせるよ……！
透ちゃんは？
trans:
I-I'll match your schedules......!
What about Toru-chan?

name: 雛菜
text:
明後日にする？
学校、終わってからとか
trans:
How about the day after tomorrow?
Some time after school.

name: 雛菜
text:
やは～！
じゃあ、決まりだね～
